overview_description.description: Alaan is a financial technology platform that provides corporate cards and expense management tools for businesses to manage company spending and financial operations. The platform enables organizations to issue physical and virtual corporate cards, set spending controls, monitor transactions in real time, and automate expense tracking and reconciliation processes. Alaan also integrates with accounting and enterprise resource planning systems, allowing finance teams to sync transaction data, invoices, and supporting documents directly into their accounting workflows. Its services include budgeting controls, approval workflows, reporting dashboards, and automated receipt and tax data extraction to support compliance and financial oversight. The platform is used by businesses across sectors such as retail, logistics, healthcare, hospitality, and professional services to centralize and manage operational expenses digitally.

about_short_description.short_description: Alaan is a financial technology company that provides corporate cards and software for managing business expenses.

product.name: Alaan Spend Management Platform
product.description: A business expense management platform for issuing cards, enforcing spending policies, routing approvals, tracking transactions, and providing real-time visibility into company expenses.

product.name: SuperCard®
product.description: Corporate cards with configurable limits and merchant restrictions for controlled business spending, real-time expense tracking, rapid balance management, and cashback on eligible expenses.

product.name: AI-Native Business Account
product.description: A business account that combines funds management, domestic payments, cards, accounts payable, accounts receivable, approvals, and accounting workflows in one AI-enabled platform.

product.name: SuperPay®
product.description: A supplier payment service for making cross-border invoice and vendor payments, with support for global transfers and foreign-exchange cost management.

product.name: Accounting Automation
product.description: Accounting automation that extracts expense data, applies accounting and tax rules, and exports transactions to accounting systems and ERPs such as Xero, QuickBooks, NetSuite, and Dynamics 365.

product.name: Alaan Intelligence
product.description: AI-based assistance for expense operations, including receipt review, expense-data extraction, expense-report preparation, and analysis of business spending.
